messages:
rachel: Heads-up from today's design review: customers get tripped up by the console label "Reserved capacity" vs our docs page "Dedicated". Can we align those two so the help panel doesn't read like a translation? noah: Good catch. We intentionally used "Reserved" in UI because it matched pricing docs, but product wants "Dedicated" in marketing. We should pick one user-facing term and add an alias note in the docs. sunita: Suggestion: keep Console label as "Dedicated (reserved)" when space allows, then in the sidecar show a small line: "Also called \u2018Reserved capacity\u2019 in billing docs." That reduces surprise without renaming everything. arne: Accessibility concern: that small inline note might be skipped by screen readers if we don't mark it. Use a visually subtle with an accessible label. rachel: Also another UX gap: our help panel has sibling links to "Performance tuning" but no contextual breadcrumbs to the routing docs. Support raised multiple tickets where users misconfigured fallback and thought the model setting was the routing policy. We need a crosslink near the top that says "Related: routing & fallback". noah: Agree. Can we make that crosslink target the in-panel sidecar rather than opening a new tab? Users lose context when the console disappears. We must ensure focus management is solid (return focus to the original control). sunita: Quick keyboard test: currently when the sidecar opens focus lands at the top of the sidecar (fine) but ESC closes it and focus goes to body. Need to capture lastActiveElement and restore. I can write the patch. arne: Microcopy nit: change help CTA from "Learn more" to "Open docs" for sidecar, and for external resources keep "Learn more" or "View on docs". This small change signals behavior to keyboard users too. rachel: Can we also add a tiny inline explainer for "variant" vs "version"? A sentence like: "Model version = staged release; variant = runtime configuration (eg int8)". Put it behind a "Why this matters" toggle so it doesn't clutter. noah: Love the toggle. Make sure it degrades gracefully: when JS disabled the short explanation should still be visible. Also we should include links to the evals page and recommended quantization settings. sunita: I'll add the accessible toggle with role=\"button\" aria-expanded and ensure it receives focus. Example: ```html
Model version = ...
``` arne: Search alias request: users search for "reserved", "reserved nodes", "dedicated pool". We should add an index_aliases array in our help metadata and map those to the canonical page. I'll make a tiny JSON patch for the help index. rachel: Action items: 1) sunita to implement focus restore + toggle accessibility; 2) arne to PR search alias mapping and update help metadata; 3) noah to update CTA copy across console components; 4) rachel to prepare the crosslink placement mock in figma and short copy for the inline note. help-bot: Related docs: https://docs.redwood.ai/console/dedicated-vs-reserved and https://docs.redwood.ai/console/routing/fallbacks — please link these in the sidecar. rachel: Thanks team. We'll validate in next design crit. If we get the alias table done early we can ship the in-panel links without confusion. :white_check_mark:
